provenance.template_comparison: Parsed XML, ignoring comments/formatting and the intentional assembly/manifest rename
provenance.unchanged_template_meaning: The template structure is inherited; shared macOS resources and runtime settings can still change its appearance
provenance.changed_template_meaning: The template structure differs from the baseline; this is not a native fidelity measurement

inherited_behavior_coverage.meaning: Static template availability from the copied WinUI foundation; this is not an executed behavior result

resource_validation.status: recorded for traceability; availability, types and live invalidation are runtime test gates

native_fidelity.meaning: Changed templates and passing structural/runtime tests do not establish native pixel, material or animation equivalence
